number_differences: The seven Table III learning-rate cells are printed as 10 with superscript −3 (PDF minus glyph); the CSV stores them as '10^-3' with an ASCII hyphen by the collection convention, so the check sees missing '−3' x7 and extra '-3' x7. Every other cell of Tables II and III was compared with a 200-dpi crop and matches.
independent_parser_number_differences: Same difference and same cause as the first parser (superscript minus glyph versus ASCII '10^-3').
